shellCommands.command: find pages -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && echo "---APP---" && find app -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat package.json && echo "---NEXTCONFIG---" && cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null

find /workspace/components /workspace/styles -type f 2>/dev/null | sort; echo "---"; cat /workspace/components/AppProvider* 2>/dev/null; echo "---css---"; cat /workspace/styles/globals.css 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "---public---"; ls /workspace/public 2>/dev/null; echo "---root---"; ls -la /workspace

grep -rn "styles/globals" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git 2>/dev/null; grep -rln "next/router\b" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git 2>/dev/null; echo "---rm---"; rm -rf pages styles; ls -la /workspace

grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/home.html /tmp/blog.html /tmp/post.html /tmp/notfound.html; echo "---"; grep -o 'Server-side rendered at[^<]*' /tmp/home.html; grep -o 'Welcome to My Blog' /tmp/home.html; grep -o 'All Blog Posts' /tmp/blog.html; grep -o '404 - Page Not Found' /tmp/notfound.html; cat /tmp/apiposts.html; echo; cat /tmp/apipost.html
pgrep -f "next dev -p 3411" | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; pgrep -f "next dev -p 3411" || echo "stopped"
ps aux | grep "next dev" | grep -v grep
ls -la /workspace/components; echo "---tsconfig diff---"; cd /workspace && git diff tsconfig.json; echo "---package.json diff---"; git diff package.json
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK" && find app components -type f | sort
